about: The parts register of Rev0.7 (design/circuit/CIRCUIT_DESIGN_Rev0.7.md 6.2). One entry per symbol.
'land' holds what the datasheet says, in the datasheet's own terms; make_libraries.py --check measures the footprint file against it.
'footprint.params' holds design choices for a generated footprint; nothing checks them except the land check and the DRC run.

'pins' maps each symbol pin number to the datasheet's pin name. A [datasheet, symbol] pair means the stock symbol spells the same pin differently; the check then compares the symbol's spelling exactly.
Lengths in mm; [min, max] pairs are datasheet tolerances. Footprint coordinates: KiCad, x right, y down, top view.
PDF page numbers count from the first page of the file; printed page numbers can differ.

Silkscreen (P5): every F.SilkS stroke is at least 0.15 mm wide and at least 0.15 mm from the footprint's own mask openings, JLCPCB's legend limits (pcb-capabilities, Legend, read 2026-11-06). A stock footprint's 0.12 mm strokes are written at 0.15 mm; 'footprint.silk_drop' names the stock footprints whose silkscreen is left out because it cannot keep 0.15 mm from their pads: non-polar parts only.

datasheet.title: TYPE-C 16PIN 2MD(073) drawing (SHOU HAN, customer copy)
datasheet.pins: PDF p1 PIN ASSIGNMENTS table and the pad labels of RECOMMENDED PCB LAYOUT (TOP VIEW): A1/B12 GND, A4/B9 VBUS, B8 SBU2, A5 CC1, B7 DN2, A6 DP1, A7 DN1, B6 DP2, A8 SBU1, B5 CC2, B4/A9 VBUS, B1/A12 GND; shell: NOTE 4-2 SHIELD
datasheet.land: PDF p1 RECOMMENDED PCB LAYOUT (TOP VIEW), THICKNESS 0.80MM, default tolerance 0.05: pad centres 6.40 / 4.80 / 3.50 / 2.50 / 1.50 / 0.50 apart, widths 0.60 (4X) and 0.30 (8X), each 4.17 to 5.32 behind the front slots' centres; slots 8.64 apart, front 0.60 x 1.40 hole in a 1.80 pad, rear 4.18 behind, 0.60 x 1.70 hole in a 2.10 pad; unplated pegs 0.65, 5.78 apart, 3.68 behind; product edge 2.60 in front of the front slots (side view); body 8.94 x 7.35 x 3.16

land.derivation: origin at the body centre, opening toward +y (top view, y down): the front slots' centres at y = 7.35 / 2 - 2.60 = 1.075; a pad row 4.17..5.32 behind them spans y -3.095..-4.245
land.deviation: A1 and B1 (GND) are 0.035 shorter at their near end (4.205..5.32 behind the front slots, not 4.17..5.32): the drawing leaves 0.165 from each peg hole to A1 and B1, under JLCPCB's 0.20 NPTH-to-track figure (pcb-capabilities, read 2026-11-12). The user's choice of 2026-11-12, 'GND パッドを 0.035 mm 短く (推奨)'; D37. A4 and B4 keep the drawing's land, 0.2006 from the peg holes at their corners.
land.slot_pad_width: DERIVED: the drawing dimensions the slot pads' length only (1.80, 2.10 over holes of 1.40, 1.70: 0.20 each end); the 1.0 width is the same 0.20 around the 0.60 hole, as in KiCad's USB_C_Receptacle_HRO_TYPE-C-31-M-12 (S1 size 1 x 2.1, drill oval 0.6 x 1.7).

notes: Each 0.60 pad carries two contacts (the drawing labels A1 B12, A4 B9, B4 A9, B1 A12); the footprint numbers it after the first, and the symbol has one pin per pad.

Pad order left to right in the top view, opening toward the viewer: A1 A4 B8 A5 B7 A6 A7 B6 A8 B5 B4 B1, so D- (B7), D+ (A6), D- (A7), D+ (B6) alternate: joining A6 to B6 and A7 to B7 needs one crossing (ROUTING_Rev0.7.md). KiCad's USB_C_Receptacle_HRO_TYPE-C-31-M-12 has the same order, A1 at -x and the opening toward +y.
DERIVED: the slot pads' 1.0 width (land.slot_pad_width).

UNCERTAIN: the drawing is for a 0.80 mm board (THICKNESS 0.80MM); this board is 1.6 mm, so the shell legs may not reach through the slots. The first board shows it (V-MFG-03); the legs are soldered by reflow from Top.
